tools.name: list_browsers
tools.description: List the shared browsers: name, status (running|stopped), who controls it (agent|human) and the CDP endpoint while running.

tools.name: start_browser
tools.description: Start (creating on first use) a persistent headless Chromium that you and the human share. Workflow: start_browser -> read the returned snippet -> run it via Bash as an .mjs script (it connects to the browser over CDP with Playwright; the browser and its tabs keep state between scripts). The project needs no Playwright install. A browser name keeps its logins and cookies across stops. The human watches and can take control in a panel: obey `controller` in the result, and while it is "human" do not drive the page, call browser_info again later. On hosts without a usable Chromium sandbox the browser runs unsandboxed: check `sandbox` in the result and avoid untrusted pages when it is false.

name.description: Browser name (lowercase letters, digits, dashes). Defaults to "default".

tools.name: stop_browser
tools.description: Stop a shared browser. Its profile (logins, cookies) is kept; start_browser brings it back.

tools.name: browser_info
tools.description: Current state of a running shared browser: CDP endpoint, open tabs, the active tab, and who controls it. Returns a ready-to-run Playwright snippet and the panel path to give the user. Call it before each script: if controller is "human" the human has taken over, so do not drive the page until it is "agent" again. The browser may run unsandboxed on hosts without a usable sandbox: check `sandbox`.
